entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this helmet I bought. This whole process is infuriating. I demand a refund right now.

I'm very sorry for any frustration this has caused. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Don't give me the runaround! It's the wrong color! The picture on your website was a bright red, and this thing is practically maroon. That's a huge issue for road safety, you know! I haven't even touched it; the box is unopened.
I see. I apologize for the discrepancy. Can I get your order number to pull up your account?
It's VF-8675309. You better handle this, or I'm plastering this experience all over the internet. This is the worst service I've ever had. Get me a manager if you can't do this simple thing.
That won't be necessary, sir. I can definitely handle this for you. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see you purchased the helmet 39 days ago.
And? Are you going to tell me I'm out of luck now? Unbelievable.

Not at all. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, I can process a full refund for you. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label and sending it to the email address on file right now.
Wait, really? A full refund? No restocking fees or other garbage?

That's correct. No fees. Just print the label, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Huh. Okay, fine. I see the email just came through. Well... that's what you should have done in the first place.
I understand. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
